title: Piping systems required to be purged outdoors.
officialText:
The purging of piping systems shall be in accordance with the
provisions of Sections 406.7.1.1 through 406.7.1.4 where the piping system meets either of the following:
1. The design operating gas pressure is greater than 2 psig (13.79 kPa).
2. The piping being purged contains one or more sections of pipe or tubing that meet(s) the size and length criteria of Table
406.7.1.1.
